description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing clients in the Fineract microfinance platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and performing various commands on client entities, as well as handling templates and external IDs.

classes.name: ClientsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing client entities, including CRUD operations, commands, templates, and external ID handling.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for client details, including defaults and allowed values, with optional narration data based on command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated and sortable list of clients based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific client by ID or external ID, with optional fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new client using provided JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing client identified by ID or external ID with provided JSON data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a client in Pending state identified by ID or external ID.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Performs various commands on a client such as activate, close, reject, withdraw, transfer, etc., based on command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves account overview for a client.

methods.name: getClientTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk client import.

methods.name: postClientTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an Excel template for bulk client import.

methods.name: retrieveObligeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves obligee details for a client.

methods.name: retrieveTransferTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a transfer proposal template for a client.

methods.name: applyCommand
methods.description: Executes a command on a client identified by ID or external ID.
